summary: Car game app with 3D cars; Version 7 deployed to production.

existing_features.title: Update the Shop page to support browsing and selecting full car designs (model/body style) with a visual preview, not just selecting colors.

projectName: Increase starting balance and show full car designs in Shop and on-track visualization
